channel.title: Pier & Point · Azure Apartments
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Azure Apartments (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Added · Azure Apartments: Azure Apartments now shows its construction permit as completed on Dec 11, 2015.
item.description: Azure Apartments now shows its construction permit as completed on Dec 11, 2015. Source: DBI building permits via DataSF (https://data.sf.gov/resource/i98e-djp9.json?permit_number=201207054130).

item.title: Correction · Azure Apartments: Azure's notes said it opened in spring 2015 and that its 234,825 sq ft Assessor figure matched press reporting exactly. The only readable press item is an August 2014 topping-out release that forecasts a spring 2015 opening and gives 396,200 sq ft, so the notes now cite the DataSF Assessor roll (year built 2015, 273 units, 16 stories, 234,825 sq ft) and say the opening was forecast, not confirmed. The completion milestone is now dated 2015 (approximate), and the topping-out milestone links the release instead of naming bare domains.
